headline: Trump replaces chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller after midterm losses

summary.headline: Trump replaces chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller after midterm losses
summary.summary: President Donald Trump announced that Susie Wiles is leaving her role as White House chief of staff and that longtime adviser Stephen Miller will assume the position. The change comes days after Republicans suffered significant defeats in the midterm elections, losing control of the Senate and many House seats. The administration said the move is part of a broader re‑organization following the electoral setback.
summary.left_angle: Left‑leaning outlets portray the swap as a reaction to internal blame, emphasizing calls for Wiles to resign and framing her removal as a concession to MAGA anger over the GOP’s midterm defeat.
summary.right_angle: Right‑leaning outlets present the change as a decisive Trump action, highlighting Miller’s appointment as a strategic reset and downplaying any notion of a forced ouster.
summary.disputed: Sources differ on whether Wiles was fired or voluntarily resigned and on who bears responsibility for the midterm losses.
